Married Woman's Suspicious Death Sparks Dowry Allegations

A married woman has died under suspicious circumstances, leading her maternal family to allege dowry harassment. A case has been registered against her husband and five others in Munger. The incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding dowry-related violence in India.
